plain_description.what: The test added an optional cache of split proposals to the tree-building engine, off by default, then rebuilt the tree with it off and on. It checked that the tree comes out identical and measured the time saved.
plain_description.why: A performance review estimated the cache could save about 37% of one build phase.
plain_description.information: It shows whether this speed-up is real and safe. Result: done. Safe, since the tree is byte-identical, but useless: 0 cache hits, because the graph changes every iteration, and the build is 49 seconds slower (55% overhead). The cache stays off and the item is closed as negative.
